ketmix.requested_by_owner: 2026-11-15: make Ketmix even smoother and more immersive, with a deeper analysis, and let titles on repeat be mixed too; first propose useful design improvements and improve Liquid Glass and its animations, from several sources with positive and negative reviews.

research.how: two background research agents; most pages were reached through search-engine extracts or fetch summaries (arxiv.org, ismir.net, nngroup.com, macstories.net and others were blocked here); Apple's HIG materials page, the Liquid Glass custom views and Spring docs were read in full
applied_to_ketmix: eight-bar phrase starts from bar-level level and spectral change (in the spirit of Foote novelty and Vande Veire & De Bie's downbeat-snapped boundaries, much simplified)
downbeats from beat-synchronous rises of level and spectral activity when the bass gives none (after Davies & Plumbley 2006, without the KL divergence)
blend order highs, mids, bass with one bass line at a time
short overlaps when a title overlaps itself (comb filtering)
repeat-one: the end blends into the start on the beat (a simple version of the jump idea of the Infinite Jukebox, without beat-similarity search)
transition style choice, a mix strip and a haptic on the bass swap, as proposed to and chosen by the owner
applied_to_glass: squircle bezel profile (kube.io) in the Liquid 27 style; the classic styles keep the circular arc after the host render test showed the squircle halved their visible refraction
Schlick Fresnel with F0 0.04 (Prismal's technical notes use Schlick)
materialize: refraction ramps in with Apple's smooth spring (0.5 s, no bounce)
release spring damping 0.68 against the 'jelly button' criticism
switch thumb turns into a lens while touched (HIG: controls become glass while interacted with)
scroll-edge legibility in every glass style (iOS 27's answer to legibility complaints)

ketmix.design_choices_by_owner: Asked with a multiple-choice question on 2026-11-15; chosen: scroll-edge legibility, queue multi-select, shuffle with fewer repeats, night-dimmed album colours, transition style choice, animated mix strip, vibration on the bass swap. Not chosen: 'listen to the mix now'.
tested_on_host: phrase detection on synthetic material whose parts change every eight bars, and none on a groove that never changes; downbeats from cymbal crashes without bass accents (BeatAnalysisTest)

the planner: mixes on phrase starts, echoes on phrase boundaries, loops (repeat one) with short overlaps, every transition style and its fallbacks, the share of the mix at which the bass changes hands (TransitionPlannerTest)
the highs-mids-bass order of the incoming filter (DeckDspTest)
shuffle with fewer repeats, queue selection rules, scroll-edge curve, spring overshoot, switch lens, mix strip levels (DesignRulesTest); night cap of page colours (CollectionHeroTest)
queue selection, the mix strip and the new Ketmix settings rendered and driven on the host (AutomixHostTest, UiPolishHostTest)
never_run_with_real_audio: nothing of the engine was executed against real audio output on any device or emulator; no transition, loop or vibration was heard or felt
phrase and downbeat detection were only checked on synthetic material, not on real music
a title on repeat played by two decks reading the same cached file at once was not exercised
the glass changes (squircle bezel in Liquid 27, Fresnel, materialize) are AGSL shaders and were not rendered on a GPU here; only the Kotlin side and the composables were exercised on the host
safeguards: off by default; any seek, title change, error, missing analysis or lack of time gives up the transition and the title ends as before
on repeat, the player's own looping is switched off only once a loop mix is planned and is given back if the mix is given up
a vibration only when the setting is on (off by default) and the app is in front

not_validated: physical phone or Quest installation, rendering and touch behaviour
Ketmix with real audio on any device or emulator (see the ketmix section)
the Liquid Glass shader changes on a GPU (squircle bezel in Liquid 27, Fresnel, materialize); the shaders were compiled and rendered in software on the host only
independent code review of this diff
known_limitations: Ketmix needs the next title to be playable without a new resolution or one that succeeds in time; otherwise it says so and the title ends as before.
A manual skip is still a plain change of title: it is not mixed.
The loop of a title on repeat blends its end into its start; it does not search the title for the most similar bars to jump between.
The mix strip is drawn from the plan of the transition, not from the audio itself.
The vibration on the bass swap only happens while the app is on screen.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
